annotations.title: Image description and OCR (read text from images)

description: Describe what is in an image, read the text in it (receipts, screenshots, signs, documents) or answer a question about it, as plain text. Compared with other image tools: budget, and one of the most used right now. Price: $0.008 per image, charged only on success. One call = one image described or read.

image.description: Public URL of the image (jpg, png or webp, up to 7 MB)

question.description: What you want to know, e.g. 'List every item and price on this receipt'. Default: describe it and copy its text

name: image-describe
